simple.meaning: אָסוּךְ (ʼâçûwk) is a Hebrew object word meaning “anointed , i.e. an oil-flask.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H610. asuk אָסוךְ noun [masculine] flask ( for pouring, anointing ); — apparently construct ׳אָ שֶׁמֶן 2Kin 4:2 , compare Kö ii. 1, 139, 401, 494 ; yet form unusual and text dubious; Gr מֶסֶךְ or מִסְכָּה ; Klo מַּךְ .
